review_kind: read-only source and existing host-log inspection; no independent execution
disposition: No blocking source regression found in the bounded Activity-observer change; ready for root compilation and emulator verification, not runtime acceptance.

findings.finding: Both journeys launch a real Activity before state/rotation observations. onActivity checks identity before copying Activity Configuration and its WindowManager current bounds. No targetContext geometry can satisfy the observer now.

Existing state-commit and config thresholds stay required; actual bounds add width/density and orientation/aspect checks. All copies are made inside onActivity. Bounds threshold and configuration threshold must both pass.
Activity remains open through guarded flat reset, rotation unfreeze, setup gate/security/no-NavDisplay and same-instance cleanup assertion; close runs in finally.

Exactly five named records remain required, now with Activity observer, integer valid bounds and orientation, matching cover/inner/short-window thresholds and object identity. Strict six alternating causal requests/console/ACKs are unchanged.
targetContext remains only the deliberate private-file transport destination. Existing leaveApksInstalledAfterRun export is unchanged; does not reintroduce non-UI geometry observation.

concrete_limits: No Kotlin compilation, ActivityScenario/emulator execution, five fresh JSONL observations, or production unlocked/IME/inference acceptance was performed by this reviewer.

ActivityWindowGeometry reads WindowManager current bounds, not drawn-frame pixel content. Identity/config/bounds checks plus Compose setup-gate assertions are this lane scope; physical sensor hinge-angle proof remains excluded.

The existing 15-second await loop checks its clock between synchronous waitForIdleSync/onActivity calls. This patch does not establish a strict wall-clock bound if the main looper hangs; the outer workflow remains the failure boundary.
